assistant-runs.cancel.title: Cancel Assistant Run
assistant-runs.cancel.description: Tool to cancel an ongoing assistant run. Use when you need to stop a run prematurely after confirming the run ID is valid.

assistant_run_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the assistant run to cancel. This run should ideally still be in progress (QUEUED or RUNNING status). If the run is already in a terminal state (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELLED), the cancellation will return the current terminal status.

data-jobs.cancel.title: Cancel Data Job
data-jobs.cancel.description: Tool to cancel a running or queued data job. Use when you need to stop a data job that is in progress or queued.

data_job_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the data job to cancel. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '107e5aaf-61b9-4925-8f0d-f65312db31af').

buckets.create.title: Create Bucket
buckets.create.description: Tool to create a new bucket in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to create storage buckets for organizing assets and data.

name.description: Name for the new bucket. Must be between 1 and 256 characters.

buckets.assets.create.title: Create Bucket Asset
buckets.assets.create.description: Tool to create a new asset in a Griptape Cloud bucket. Use when you need to add a new asset to a bucket by specifying its name.

bucket_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the bucket to create the asset in.

name.description: The name of the asset to create. Must be between 1 and 256 characters.

data-connectors.create.title: Create Data Connector
data-connectors.create.description: Tool to create a new data connector in Griptape Cloud. Data connectors enable ingestion from various sources like web pages, Confluence, Google Drive, S3, or data lakes. After creation, the connector can automatically sync data to knowledge bases based on the configured schedule.

config.description: Configuration object for the data connector. Exactly one connector type field must be populated based on the 'type' field.

description.description: Optional description of the data connector's purpose. Max 200 characters.

name.description: Name for the data connector. Must be 1-200 characters.

schedule_expression.description: Optional cron expression for scheduling automatic data syncs (e.g., 'cron(0 12 * * ? *)').

transforms.description: Optional list of transform structures to apply to the data during ingestion.

type.description: Type of data connector. Must match the config field provided (e.g., 'webscraper', 'confluence', 'google_drive', 'structure', 's3', 'data_lake').

data-connectors.jobs.create.title: Create Data Connector Job
data-connectors.jobs.create.description: Tool to create a data job for a data connector in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to trigger data ingestion or processing for a specific data connector. The job will be queued and executed asynchronously.

data_connector_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the data connector to create a job for. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

export-jobs.create.title: Create Export Job
export-jobs.create.description: Tool to create a new export job in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to initiate an export operation with custom data.

export_data.description: Flexible JSON object containing the data to be exported. Can contain any valid JSON structure with no strict schema constraints.

metadata.description: Optional metadata object with additional properties describing the export job.

functions.create.title: Create Function
functions.create.description: Tool to create a new function in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to register a new serverless function with optional code configuration and environment variables.

code.description: Code configuration for the function. Can be GitHub, data lake, or default configuration. If omitted, function is created without code and can be configured later.

description.description: Brief description of the function's purpose. Max 200 characters.

env_vars.description: List of environment variables for the function.

function_config_file.description: Path to the function configuration file (1-200 characters).

name.description: Name for the function. Must be 1-200 characters.

functions.deployments.create.title: Create Function Deployment
functions.deployments.create.description: Tool to create a new deployment for a function from a code source. Use when you need to deploy a function from a GitHub repository to Griptape Cloud.

function_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the function to create a deployment for.

code_source.description: Source code configuration specifying where to pull the code from (currently supports GitHub).

force.description: If true, forces deployment even if another deployment is in progress. Use with caution.

import-jobs.create.title: Create Import Job
import-jobs.create.description: Tool to create a new import job in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to initiate a data import operation from a data lake asset (e.g., S3 bucket) into Griptape Cloud.

data_lake_asset_path.description: Path to the data lake asset (e.g., s3://bucket-name/path/to/data). Required field specifying the source location of data to import.

import_type.description: Type of import operation to perform. Required field that specifies the kind of data being imported.

metadata.description: Additional key-value metadata for the import job. Can contain arbitrary information relevant to the import operation.

resource_suffix.description: Suffix to append to imported resources. Useful for versioning or distinguishing multiple imports.

integrations.create.title: Create Integration
integrations.create.description: Tool to create a new integration in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to register a new integration (slack, github_app, or webhook) to connect external services with assistants or structures.

assistant_ids.description: List of assistant UUIDs to associate with this integration.

config.description: Configuration object for the integration. Structure depends on the integration type. For webhook, use {'webhook': {}}. For slack, use {'slack': {}}. For github_app, use {'github_app': {}}.

description.description: Brief description of the integration's purpose. Max 200 characters.

name.description: Name for the integration. Must be 1-200 characters.

structure_ids.description: List of structure UUIDs to associate with this integration.

knowledge-bases.create.title: Create Knowledge Base
knowledge-bases.create.description: Tool to create a new knowledge base in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to set up a vector store for document indexing and semantic search.

asset_paths.description: List of asset paths to associate with this knowledge base.

config.description: Configuration object for the knowledge base. Type must match the 'type' field. For most cases, use an empty dict for the selected config type.

description.description: Brief description of the knowledge base. Max 200 characters.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model to use. Options: 'text-embedding-ada-002' or 'text-embedding-3-small'.

name.description: Name for the knowledge base. Must be 1-200 characters.

transforms.description: List of transforms to apply to the knowledge base.

type.description: Type of knowledge base. Must match the config type: 'pg_vector', 'gtc_pg_vector', 'gtc_hybrid_sql_pg_vector', or 'pgai_knowledge_base'.

use_default_embedding_model.description: Whether to use the default embedding model. If true, embedding_model field is ignored.

knowledge-bases.jobs.create.title: Create Knowledge Base Job
knowledge-bases.jobs.create.description: Tool to create a knowledge base job for ingesting data into a knowledge base. Use when you need to trigger data ingestion or processing for a specific knowledge base.

knowledge_base_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the knowledge base to create a job for.

libraries.create.title: Create Library
libraries.create.description: Tool to create a new library in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to organize data connectors and knowledge bases for an assistant to use.

data_connector_ids.description: List of data connector UUIDs to include in this library. Data connectors define data sources to ingest.

description.description: Brief description of the library's purpose. Max 256 characters.

knowledge_base_configs.description: List of knowledge base configurations. Each config must specify exactly one backend type (pg_vector, gtc_pg_vector, gtc_hybrid_sql_pg_vector, or pgai_knowledge_base).

name.description: Name for the library. Must be 1-64 characters.

models.create.title: Create Model Configuration
models.create.description: Tool to create a new model configuration in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to register a new model with specific authentication and configuration settings before using it in assistants or other Griptape resources.

active.description: Whether the model configuration should be active. If not specified, defaults to true.

auth_config_id.description: UUID of the authentication configuration to use for this model. Must be a valid UUID v4 format. Obtain this from auth config creation or listing responses.

description.description: Brief description of the model configuration and its intended use case.

kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for the model configuration (e.g., temperature, max_tokens).

model_name.description: Name of the model to configure (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'claude-3-opus'). Must be 1-1000 characters.

models.auth-configs.create.title: Create Model Auth Config
models.auth-configs.create.description: Tool to create a model authentication configuration in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to set up new authentication for a model API endpoint.

api_key_secret_id.description: UUID of the API key secret to use for authentication. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

base_url.description: Base URL for the model API endpoint.

name.description: Name of the model auth config (1-200 characters).

organizations.api-keys.create.title: Create Organization API Key
organizations.api-keys.create.description: Tool to create a new API key for a specific organization. Use when you need to generate a new API key for authentication purposes. The API key value is only returned once during creation.

organization_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the organization to create the API key for.

name.description: Name of the API key. Must be between 1 and 200 characters.

retrievers.create.title: Create Retriever
retrievers.create.description: Tool to create a new retriever in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to create a retriever with associated components for document retrieval capabilities.

description.description: Description of the retriever's purpose. Must be 1-256 characters if provided.

name.description: Name for the retriever. Must be 1-64 characters.

retriever_component_ids.description: List of existing retriever component UUIDs to associate with this retriever. Each ID must be a valid UUID v4 format.

retriever_components.description: List of new retriever component objects to create for this retriever. Each component must have 'name' and 'type' fields.

rules.create.title: Create Rule
rules.create.description: Tool to create a new rule in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to define behavioral guidelines or constraints for AI assistants.

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata to associate with the rule. Can contain arbitrary data for organizational purposes.

name.description: Name for the rule. Must be 1-200 characters. This identifies the rule within the Griptape Cloud.

rule.description: The rule content or definition text. Must be 1-2000 characters. This is the actual behavioral guideline or constraint.

secrets.create.title: Create Secret
secrets.create.description: Tool to create a new secret in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to store sensitive information like API keys, passwords, or tokens.

name.description: Name of the secret. Must be between 1 and 200 characters.

value.description: Value of the secret. Must be between 1 and 200 characters.

structures.create.title: Create Structure
structures.create.description: Tool to create a new structure in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to register a workflow or data processing pipeline that can be deployed and executed.

code.description: Code source configuration. Can be GitHub, data lake, or default. Specify exactly one of the source types.

description.description: Brief description of the structure's purpose. Max 200 characters.

env_vars.description: List of environment variables to configure for the structure.

name.description: Name for the structure. Must be 1-200 characters.

structure_config_file.description: Path to the structure configuration file. Max 200 characters.

webhook_enabled.description: Whether to enable webhook functionality for this structure.

structures.deployments.create.title: Create Structure Deployment
structures.deployments.create.description: Tool to create a new deployment for a structure. Use when you need to deploy a structure from a GitHub repository to Griptape Cloud.

structure_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the structure to deploy.

code_source.description: Code source configuration specifying where to deploy the structure code from.

force.description: Force deployment even if a deployment is already in progress. Use with caution.

threads.messages.create.title: Create Thread Message
threads.messages.create.description: Tool to create a new message in a specific thread. Use when you need to add a message with input and output content to a conversation thread in Griptape Cloud.

thread_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the thread to create the message in.

input.description: The input content of the message.

metadata.description: Additional metadata to associate with the message.

output.description: The output content or response of the message.

tools.deployments.create.title: Create Tool Deployment
tools.deployments.create.description: Create a new deployment for a tool from a GitHub repository. Use when you need to deploy or update tool code from a GitHub source. The deployment process is asynchronous - use the Get Tool Deployment Status action to poll for completion.

tool_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the tool to deploy. Obtain this from the List Tools or Create Tool action.

code_source.description: Source code configuration specifying the GitHub repository to deploy from.

force.description: Whether to force deployment even if there are no code changes. Set to true to redeploy with the same code.

api-keys.delete.title: Delete API Key
api-keys.delete.description: Tool to delete an API key by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove an API key from Griptape Cloud.

api_key_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the API key to delete.

buckets.delete.title: Delete Bucket
buckets.delete.description: Tool to delete a bucket by ID. Use when you need to remove a specific bucket from Griptape Cloud.

bucket_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the bucket to delete.

buckets.assets.delete.title: Delete Bucket Asset
buckets.assets.delete.description: Tool to delete a specific asset from a Griptape Cloud bucket. Use when you need to remove an asset from a bucket by name.

name.description: The name of the asset to delete from the bucket.

bucket_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the bucket containing the asset.

data-connectors.delete.title: Delete Data Connector
data-connectors.delete.description: Tool to delete a data connector. Use when you need to permanently remove a data connector from Griptape Cloud.

data_connector_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the data connector to delete. This operation is irreversible and will permanently remove the data connector.

functions.delete.title: Delete Function
functions.delete.description: Tool to delete a function from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to permanently remove a function by its ID.

function_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the function to delete.

integrations.delete.title: Delete Integration
integrations.delete.description: Tool to delete an integration by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove an integration from Griptape Cloud.

integration_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the integration to delete. This will permanently remove the integration from Griptape Cloud.

knowledge-bases.delete.title: Delete Knowledge Base
knowledge-bases.delete.description: Tool to delete a Knowledge Base from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to permanently remove a knowledge base and all its associated data. This operation cannot be undone.

knowledge_base_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Knowledge Base to delete. Can be found in the Griptape Cloud console Config tab.

libraries.delete.title: Delete Library
libraries.delete.description: Tool to delete a library from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to permanently remove a library resource.

library_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the library to delete.

messages.delete.title: Delete Message
messages.delete.description: Tool to delete a message by its ID. Use when you need to remove a specific message from Griptape Cloud.

message_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the message to delete.

models.delete.title: Delete Model Configuration
models.delete.description: Tool to delete a model configuration from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to permanently remove a model configuration.

model_config_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the model configuration to delete. This will permanently remove the model configuration from Griptape Cloud. Obtain this ID from model listing or creation responses.

models.auth-configs.delete.title: Delete Model Auth Config
models.auth-configs.delete.description: Tool to delete a model auth config by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a model authentication configuration from Griptape Cloud.

auth_config_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the model auth config to delete.

rules.delete.title: Delete Rule
rules.delete.description: Tool to delete a rule by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a rule from Griptape Cloud.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the rule to delete. The rule must exist in the Griptape Cloud and belong to your organization.

rulesets.delete.title: Delete Ruleset
rulesets.delete.description: Tool to permanently delete a ruleset from Griptape Cloud by its ID. Use when you need to remove a ruleset and all its associated rules. This operation cannot be undone.

ruleset_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the ruleset to delete. This permanently removes the ruleset and its associated rules from Griptape Cloud.

secrets.delete.title: Delete Secret
secrets.delete.description: Tool to delete a secret from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to permanently remove a secret by its ID.

secret_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the secret to delete. This operation is irreversible.

structures.delete.title: Delete Structure
structures.delete.description: Tool to delete a structure from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to permanently remove a structure by its ID. This operation is irreversible.

structure_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the structure to delete. This action is irreversible and will permanently remove the structure from your account.

threads.delete.title: Delete Thread
threads.delete.description: Tool to delete a thread by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a conversation thread and all its associated messages from Griptape Cloud.

thread_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the thread to delete. Once deleted, the thread and all its associated messages will be permanently removed.

tools.delete.title: Delete Tool
tools.delete.description: Tool to delete a tool from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to permanently remove a tool resource by its ID.

tool_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the tool to delete.

api-keys.get.title: Get API Key
api-keys.get.description: Tool to retrieve an API key's details. Use when you need to get information about a specific API key by its ID.

api_key_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the API key to retrieve.

billing.management-url.create.title: Get Billing Management URL
billing.management-url.create.description: Tool to retrieve the billing management portal URL. Use when you need to access or redirect users to the billing portal for subscription or payment management.

buckets.get.title: Get Bucket
buckets.get.description: Tool to retrieve a bucket's details by its ID. Use when you need to fetch information about a specific bucket in Griptape Cloud.

bucket_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the bucket to retrieve. This is a UUID v4 format identifier (e.g., '599a4d24-cda7-4ccf-9b72-6484294c6c87').

buckets.assets.get.title: Get Bucket Asset
buckets.assets.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific asset from a Griptape Cloud bucket. Use when you need to fetch asset metadata or contents from a bucket by name.

name.description: The name of the asset to retrieve from the bucket.

bucket_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the bucket containing the asset.

include_contents.description: Set to true to include the asset contents in the response. Set to false to retrieve only metadata. Defaults to false if not specified.

buckets.assets.url.create.title: Get Bucket Asset URL
buckets.assets.url.create.description: Tool to generate a signed URL for accessing or uploading bucket assets. Use when you need a temporary URL to GET (download) or PUT (upload) an asset in a Griptape Cloud bucket.

name.description: The name or path of the asset in the bucket for which to generate a signed URL.

bucket_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the bucket containing the asset.

config.get.title: Get Configuration
config.get.description: Tool to retrieve Griptape Cloud configuration. Use when you need to access data lake settings or Google Drive connector configuration.

credits.balance.get.title: Get Credits Balance
credits.balance.get.description: Tool to retrieve the current credits balance. Use when you need to check available credits for billing or usage tracking.

data-connectors.get.title: Get Data Connector
data-connectors.get.description: Tool to retrieve a data connector's configuration and details from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need information about a specific data connector including its type, configuration, and metadata.

data_connector_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the data connector to retrieve. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

data-jobs.get.title: Get Data Job
data-jobs.get.description: Tool to retrieve a data job's status and details by its ID. Use when you need to check the current status, ingestion progress, or errors for a specific data job.

data_job_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the data job to retrieve. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '85e0625a-18e4-410a-bf28-b8cb745f5141').

export-jobs.get.title: Get Export Job
export-jobs.get.description: Tool to retrieve an export job by ID. Use when you need to check the status or details of an export operation.

export_job_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the export job to retrieve.

functions.get.title: Get Function
functions.get.description: Tool to retrieve a function's details. Use when you need to get configuration, environment variables, or metadata for a specific function in Griptape Cloud.

function_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the function to retrieve. Obtain this from function creation or listing.

import-jobs.get.title: Get Import Job
import-jobs.get.description: Tool to retrieve an import job's status and details. Use when you need to check the current status and metadata for a specific import job.

import_job_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the import job to retrieve.

integrations.get.title: Get Integration
integrations.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific integration's details by ID. Use when you need detailed information about a particular integration including its configuration, associated assistants, and structures.

integration_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the integration to retrieve. This is a UUID v4 format identifier (e.g., '897003ec-49cd-4e5f-9ace-c5c721ce2222').

knowledge-bases.get.title: Get Knowledge Base
knowledge-bases.get.description: Tool to retrieve a knowledge base's configuration and details from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need information about a specific knowledge base including its type, configuration, embedding model, and metadata.

knowledge_base_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the knowledge base to retrieve. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

knowledge-bases.jobs.get.title: Get Knowledge Base Job
knowledge-bases.jobs.get.description: Tool to retrieve a knowledge base job's status and details by its ID. Use when you need to check the current status, ingestion progress, or errors for a specific knowledge base job.

knowledge_base_job_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the knowledge base job to retrieve. Must be in UUID format.

knowledge-bases.searches.get.title: Get Knowledge Base Search
knowledge-bases.searches.get.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific knowledge base search by its ID. Use when you need to fetch results of a previously executed knowledge base search.

knowledge_base_search_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the knowledge base search to retrieve.

libraries.get.title: Get Library
libraries.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific library's details by ID. Use when you need detailed information about a library including its associated assistant, retrievers, knowledge bases, and data connectors.

library_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the library to retrieve.

messages.get.title: Get Message
messages.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific message's details by ID. Use when you need detailed information about a particular message from a thread.

message_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the message to retrieve.

models.get.title: Get Model Configuration
models.get.description: Tool to retrieve a model configuration's details by its ID. Use when you need to get information about a specific model configuration in Griptape Cloud, including its name, type, authentication settings, and metadata.

model_config_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the model configuration to retrieve. This is a UUID v4 format identifier. Obtain this from model creation or listing responses.

models.auth-configs.get.title: Get Model Auth Config
models.auth-configs.get.description: Tool to retrieve a model auth config by ID. Use when you need to get configuration details for model authentication in Griptape Cloud.

auth_config_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the model auth config to retrieve.

retrievers.get.title: Get Retriever
retrievers.get.description: Tool to retrieve a retriever's details by its ID. Use when you need to fetch information about a specific retriever in Griptape Cloud, including its components and configuration.

retriever_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the retriever to retrieve. This is a UUID v4 format identifier.

retriever-components.get.title: Get Retriever Component
retriever-components.get.description: Tool to retrieve a retriever component's details by its ID. Use when you need to fetch information about a specific retriever component in Griptape Cloud.

retriever_component_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the retriever component to retrieve. This is a UUID v4 format identifier.

rules.get.title: Get Rule
rules.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific rule's details by ID. Use when you need detailed information about a particular rule including its content, metadata, and timestamps.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the rule to retrieve. The rule must exist in the Griptape Cloud and belong to your organization.

rulesets.get.title: Get Ruleset
rulesets.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific ruleset's details by ID. Use when you need detailed information about a particular ruleset including its name, rules, metadata, and timestamps.

ruleset_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the ruleset to retrieve. The ruleset must exist in Griptape Cloud and belong to your organization.

rulesets.get_by_alias.title: Get Ruleset by Alias
rulesets.get_by_alias.description: Retrieve a ruleset from Griptape Cloud by its unique alias identifier. The alias is typically an auto-generated 32-character hash (e.g., 'e9990de9925a40d1b8fce8455c63651f') created when the ruleset was first created, unless a custom alias was provided during creation. Returns the full ruleset details including name, metadata, rule IDs, and timestamps. Returns an empty list if no ruleset matches the given alias.

alias.description: The unique alias identifier of the ruleset to retrieve. This is an auto-generated hash (e.g., 'e9990de9925a40d1b8fce8455c63651f') assigned when the ruleset is created, unless a custom alias was provided during creation.

secrets.get.title: Get Secret
secrets.get.description: Tool to retrieve a secret's details from Griptape Cloud. Use when you need information about a specific secret including its name, organization, and usage timestamps.

secret_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the secret to retrieve. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

dashboards.structures.get.title: Get Structures Dashboard
dashboards.structures.get.description: Tool to retrieve dashboard metrics for structures. Use when you need analytics on deployments, runs, errors, durations, and token usage.

start_time.description: Start time for the dashboard time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). If not provided, uses system default.

end_time.description: End time for the dashboard time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'). If not provided, uses current time.

structure_ids.description: Comma-separated list of structure IDs to filter the dashboard metrics. If not provided, includes all structures.

tools.get.title: Get Tool
tools.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific tool's details by ID. Use when you need detailed information about a particular tool including its configuration, environment variables, and deployment status.

tool_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the tool to retrieve. Obtain this from tool creation or listing.

usage.get.title: Get Usage
usage.get.description: Tool to retrieve current usage statistics. Use when you need to check bytes ingested, RAG queries, runtime seconds, and their respective limits for the billing period.

users.get.title: Get User
users.get.description: Tool to retrieve a user's details by their ID. Use when you need information about a specific user including their email, name, and organization memberships.

assistant-runs.events.list.title: List Assistant Run Events
assistant-runs.events.list.description: Tool to list events for an assistant run with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve execution events in a paginated manner, as opposed to streaming them.

assistant_run_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the assistant run to list events for. Obtain this from the assistant run creation response or listing.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, must be >= 1. Use this to control page size.

offset.description: Number of events to skip before returning results, must be >= 0. Use this with limit for pagination.

buckets.assets.list.title: List Bucket Assets
buckets.assets.list.description: Tool to list assets in a bucket. Use when you need to retrieve files stored in a Griptape Cloud bucket. Supports pagination and filtering by name prefix/postfix.

page.description: Page number for pagination, must be >= 1.

page_size.description: Number of assets per page, must be >= 1.

prefix.description: Filter assets by name prefix. Only assets whose names start with this string will be returned.

postfix.description: Filter assets by name postfix. Only assets whose names end with this string will be returned.

connections.list.title: List Connections
connections.list.description: Tool to list all connections. Use after authenticating with Griptape Cloud to retrieve available connections. Supports optional pagination and type filtering.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Must be >= 1.

page_size.description: Number of connections to return per page. Must be >= 1.

data-connectors.list.title: List Data Connectors
data-connectors.list.description: Tool to list all data connectors. Use when you need to discover available data connectors and their configurations in Griptape Cloud. Supports pagination.

page_size.description: Number of data connectors per page. Must be >= 1.

page_size.description: Number of export jobs to return per page. Must be >= 1.

status.description: List of statuses to filter by (e.g., ['QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED']).

functions.deployments.list.title: List Function Deployments

status.description: List of statuses to filter knowledge base jobs by (e.g., ['QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED']). If not provided, all jobs are returned.

knowledge-bases.queries.list.title: List Knowledge Base Queries

page.description: Page number for pagination. Must be >= 1.

libraries.list.title: List Libraries
libraries.list.description: Tool to list all libraries in Griptape Cloud. Use after authenticating to retrieve available libraries with pagination support.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Must be >= 1.

models.auth-configs.list.title: List Model Auth Configs
models.auth-configs.list.description: Tool to list all model authentication configurations with optional pagination. Use when you need to discover available model auth configs and their IDs in Griptape Cloud.

secrets.list.title: List Secrets
secrets.list.description: Tool to list all secrets in Griptape Cloud. Use to retrieve available secrets with optional pagination.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Must be >= 1.

page_size.description: Number of secrets to return per page. Must be >= 1.

structures.deployments.list.title: List Structure Deployments
structures.deployments.list.description: Tool to list all deployments for a specific structure. Use when you need to retrieve deployment history and status for a structure in Griptape Cloud.

structure_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the structure to list deployments for.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Must be >= 1.

structures.runs.list.title: List Structure Runs
structures.runs.list.description: Tool to list all runs for a specific structure with optional pagination and status filtering. Use when you need to retrieve historical execution runs for a structure.

structure_id.description: Unique identifier of the structure to list runs for. Use the Get Structures Dashboard or related actions to find available structure IDs.

page_size.description: Number of structure runs to return per page. Must be >= 1.

tools.runs.list.description: Tool to list all runs for a specific tool with optional pagination and status filtering. Use when you need to retrieve historical execution runs for a tool.

knowledge-bases.query.title: Query knowledge base
knowledge-bases.query.description: Performs semantic search against a Griptape Cloud knowledge base using natural language. Returns matching entries with similarity scores and metadata. Use this when you need to retrieve raw vector search results from a knowledge base. For a higher-level natural language answer, use the Search Knowledge Base action instead.

knowledge_base_id.description: UUID of the Knowledge Base to query. Can be found in the Griptape Cloud console.

query.description: Natural-language query text to search for in the knowledge base

query_args.description: Additional options for querying the knowledge base

retrievers.query.title: Query Retriever
retrievers.query.description: Tool to query a retriever in Griptape Cloud with a natural-language query. Use when you need to retrieve information using a configured retriever, which may include reranking and multi-knowledge-base search capabilities.

retriever_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the retriever to query. This is a UUID v4 format identifier.

query.description: Natural-language query text to search for using the retriever. Must not be empty.

retriever_components_query_args.description: Optional query arguments for retriever components to customize the retrieval behavior.

rulesets.create.title: Ruleset Creation
rulesets.create.description: Creates a new ruleset in Griptape Cloud. Rulesets are containers for rules that define behavioral guidelines for AI assistants. After creation, you can add rules to the ruleset and attach it to assistants to control their behavior.

description.description: description.

metadata.description: Optional key-value pairs for storing custom attributes with the ruleset (e.g., version, category, priority)

name.description: Human-readable name for the new ruleset. This name identifies the ruleset in the Griptape Cloud.

knowledge-bases.search.title: Search Knowledge Base
knowledge-bases.search.description: Searches a Griptape Cloud Knowledge Base with a natural-language query and returns a synthesized answer. Use this tool when you need to: - Retrieve information from a specific knowledge base using natural language - Get AI-synthesized answers based on documents stored in a knowledge base - Query company documentation, FAQs, or other indexed content Prerequisites: You need a valid Knowledge Base ID, which can be found in the Griptape Cloud console. Example queries: - "What is the refund policy?" - "How do I reset my password?" - "What are the supported file formats?"

knowledge_base_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Knowledge Base to search. Can be found in the Griptape Cloud console Config tab.

query.description: A natural-language question to search against the Knowledge Base. Must not be empty.

tools.create.title: Create Tool
tools.create.description: Create a new tool resource in Griptape Cloud. Use this to register a new tool that can be configured and deployed later. The tool code can be added via the Griptape Cloud console after creation.

description.description: Description of the tool's purpose (1-200 characters).

name.description: Unique name for the tool (1-200 characters).

deployments.get.title: Get Tool Deployment Status
deployments.get.description: Tool to retrieve status of a specific tool deployment. Use after creating a deployment to poll its progress.

deployment_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the specific deployment to query. Obtain this from the tool's deployment history.

tools.list.title: List Tools
tools.list.description: Tool to list all tools. Use when you need to discover available tools and their IDs in Griptape Cloud.

buckets.update.title: Update Bucket
buckets.update.description: Tool to update a bucket's properties by its ID. Use when you need to modify bucket details such as the name in Griptape Cloud.

bucket_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the bucket to update. This is a UUID v4 format identifier (e.g., '599a4d24-cda7-4ccf-9b72-6484294c6c87').

name.description: New name for the bucket. Must be between 1 and 256 characters.

data-connectors.update.title: Update Data Connector
data-connectors.update.description: Tool to update a data connector's configuration in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to modify an existing data connector's name, description, schedule, or configuration settings.

data_connector_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the data connector to update. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

config.description: Updated configuration for the data connector. Structure varies by connector type (e.g., {'confluence': {...}}, {'google_drive': {...}}, {'webscraper': {...}}, {'structure': {...}}, {'s3': {...}}, {'data_lake': {...}}).

description.description: Updated description of the data connector's purpose. Must be 1-200 characters.

name.description: Updated name for the data connector. Must be 1-200 characters.

schedule_expression.description: Updated cron or schedule expression for automated data syncing. Must be 1-200 characters.

functions.update.title: Update Function
functions.update.description: Tool to update an existing function's configuration. Use when you need to modify a function's name, description, code configuration, environment variables, or configuration file path.

function_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the function to update.

code.description: Schema representing the code configuration for a function.

description.description: Updated description of the function. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

env_vars.description: Updated list of environment variables for the function.

function_config_file.description: Updated path to the function configuration file. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

name.description: Updated name for the function. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

integrations.update.title: Update Integration
integrations.update.description: Tool to update an existing integration's configuration. Use when you need to modify an integration's name, description, type, configuration, or associated resources like assistants and structures.

integration_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the integration to update.

assistant_ids.description: Updated list of assistant IDs (UUIDs) to associate with this integration.

config.description: Updated configuration settings for the integration. Structure varies based on integration type (slack, github_app, or webhook).

description.description: Updated description of the integration. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

name.description: New name for the integration. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

structure_ids.description: Updated list of structure IDs (UUIDs) to associate with this integration.

type.description: Updated type of the integration. Must be one of: slack, github_app, or webhook.

knowledge-bases.update.title: Update Knowledge Base
knowledge-bases.update.description: Tool to update a knowledge base's configuration in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to modify a knowledge base's type, config, description, name, embedding model, or other properties.

knowledge_base_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the knowledge base to update. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

asset_paths.description: Updated list of asset paths to associate with this knowledge base.

config.description: Configuration for the knowledge base vector store.

description.description: Updated description of the knowledge base's purpose. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

embedding_model.description: The embedding model to use. Valid values: 'text-embedding-ada-002', 'text-embedding-3-small'.

name.description: New name for the knowledge base. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

schedule_expression.description: Cron or schedule expression for automated knowledge base updates. Must be 1-200 characters.

transforms.description: List of transformations to apply to the knowledge base data.

type.description: Type of the knowledge base (e.g., 'gtc_pg_vector', 'pg_vector', 'gtc_hybrid_sql_pg_vector'). Must be 1-200 characters.

use_default_embedding_model.description: Whether to use the default embedding model for this knowledge base.

libraries.update.title: Update Library
libraries.update.description: Tool to update an existing library's configuration in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to modify a library's name, description, data connectors, or knowledge base configurations.

library_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the library to update.

data_connector_ids.description: Updated list of data connector UUIDs to associate with this library. Can be an empty list.

description.description: Updated description of the library's purpose. Must be between 1 and 256 characters if provided.

knowledge_base_configs.description: Updated list of knowledge base configuration objects. Each config must specify one of: pg_vector, gtc_pg_vector, gtc_hybrid_sql_pg_vector, or pgai_knowledge_base.

name.description: Updated name for the library. Must be between 1 and 64 characters.

messages.update.title: Update Message
messages.update.description: Tool to update a message's input, output, and metadata by its ID. Use when you need to modify message content or associated metadata in Griptape Cloud.

message_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the message to update. UUID v4 format (e.g., '4fe85c9a-c3e9-4a10-8985-705ba0694b62').

input.description: Updated input content of the message. The text or prompt that was sent to the assistant.

metadata.description: Updated metadata associated with the message. Can contain any additional key-value pairs.

output.description: Updated output content or response of the message. The assistant's response.

models.update.title: Update Model Configuration
models.update.description: Tool to update a model configuration's properties by its ID. Use when you need to modify model details such as name, description, type, authentication settings, or activation status in Griptape Cloud.

model_config_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the model configuration to update. This is a UUID v4 format identifier. Obtain this from model creation or listing responses.

active.description: Whether the model configuration should be active. Set to true to enable, false to disable.

auth_config_id.description: UUID of the authentication configuration to use for this model. Must be a valid UUID v4 format. This links the model to specific API credentials.

description.description: Updated description of the model configuration's purpose or characteristics.

kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for the model configuration. Use for provider-specific settings.

model_name.description: Updated name of the model (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'claude-3-opus'). Must be 1-1000 characters.

models.auth-configs.update.title: Update Model Auth Config
models.auth-configs.update.description: Tool to update an existing model auth config's properties. Use when you need to modify a model authentication configuration's name, API key secret, base URL, or additional kwargs in Griptape Cloud.

auth_config_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the model auth config to update.

api_key_secret_id.description: UUID of the API key secret to associate with this auth config.

base_url.description: Base URL for the model API endpoint.

kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments for the auth config.

name.description: New name for the model auth config. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

organizations.update.title: Update Organization
organizations.update.description: Tool to update an organization's properties by its ID. Use when you need to modify organization details such as the name or model configuration settings in Griptape Cloud.

organization_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the organization to update. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

name.description: New name for the organization. Must be between 1 and 200 characters if provided.

retrievers.update.title: Update Retriever
retrievers.update.description: Tool to update an existing retriever's configuration in Griptape Cloud. Use when you need to modify a retriever's name, description, or associated retriever components.

retriever_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the retriever to update. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

description.description: Updated description of the retriever's purpose. Must be 1-256 characters.

name.description: Updated name for the retriever. Must be 1-64 characters.

retriever_component_ids.description: Updated list of retriever component UUIDs to associate with this retriever. Each ID must be a valid UUID v4 format.

retriever_components.description: Updated list of retriever component objects to create or update for this retriever. Each component must have 'name' and 'type' fields.

retriever-components.update.title: Update Retriever Component
retriever-components.update.description: Tool to update a retriever component's configuration by its ID. Use when you need to modify properties such as name, description, type, or configuration of a retriever component in Griptape Cloud.

retriever_component_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the retriever component to update. This is a UUID v4 format identifier.

config.description: Configuration settings for the retriever component. This is a required field containing the component's configuration.

description.description: Updated description of the retriever component's purpose or functionality. Must be between 1 and 256 characters if provided.

name.description: New name for the retriever component. Must be between 1 and 64 characters if provided.

type.description: Type of the retriever component. This is a required field that specifies the component type.

rules.update.title: Update Rule
rules.update.description: Tool to update an existing rule's configuration. Use when you need to modify a rule's name, content, or metadata.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the rule to update. The rule must exist in Griptape Cloud and belong to your organization.

metadata.description: Updated key-value metadata to associate with the rule. Can contain arbitrary data for organizational purposes.

name.description: New name for the rule. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

rule.description: Updated rule content or definition text. Must be 1-2000 characters if provided.

rulesets.update.title: Update Ruleset
rulesets.update.description: Tool to update an existing ruleset's configuration. Use when you need to modify a ruleset's name, description, alias, rules, or metadata.

ruleset_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the ruleset to update.

alias.description: Updated alias identifier for the ruleset. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

description.description: Updated description of the ruleset. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

metadata.description: Updated key-value metadata pairs for storing custom attributes with the ruleset.

name.description: Updated name for the ruleset. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

rule_ids.description: Updated list of rule UUIDs to associate with this ruleset.

secrets.update.title: Update Secret
secrets.update.description: Tool to update a secret's properties by its ID. Use when you need to modify secret details such as the name or value in Griptape Cloud.

secret_id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the secret to update. Must be a valid UUID v4 format.

name.description: New name for the secret. Must be between 1 and 200 characters if provided.

value.description: New value for the secret. Must be between 1 and 200 characters if provided.

structures.update.title: Update Structure
structures.update.description: Tool to update an existing structure's configuration. Use when you need to modify a structure's name, description, code configuration, environment variables, or webhook settings.

structure_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the structure to update.

code.description: Schema representing the code configuration for a structure.

description.description: Updated description of the structure's purpose. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

env_vars.description: Updated list of environment variables configured for the structure.

name.description: New name for the structure. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

structure_config_file.description: Updated path to the structure configuration file. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

webhook_enabled.description: Whether to enable or disable webhooks for this structure.

threads.update.title: Update Thread
threads.update.description: Tool to update an existing thread's configuration. Use when you need to modify a thread's name, alias, metadata, or messages in Griptape Cloud.

thread_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the thread to update.

alias.description: New alias for the thread. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

messages.description: List of messages to add or update in the thread. Each message requires 'input' and 'output' fields.

metadata.description: Additional metadata to associate with the thread.

name.description: New name for the thread. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

tools.update.title: Update Tool
tools.update.description: Tool to update an existing tool's configuration. Use when you need to modify a tool's name, description, code configuration, environment variables, or configuration file path.

tool_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the tool to update.

code.description: Schema representing the code configuration for a tool.

description.description: Updated description of the tool. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

env_vars.description: Updated list of environment variables for the tool.

name.description: Updated name for the tool. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.

tool_config_file.description: Updated path to the tool configuration file. Must be 1-200 characters if provided.
